Run one version of a project in a new R session

Source: R/run_version.R
run_version.Rd

run_version() runs <home>/<version>_run.R with callr::rscript() in a new R session, with home as the working directory. It stops, and shows the output of the script, when the script fails.

Usage

run_version(version, data_raw = NULL, home = ".")

Arguments

version

The version, for example "v01".

data_raw

NULL, or the path of a raw data folder. A path goes to the script as the trailing command-line argument data_raw=<path>, which initialize_project() reads.

home

The project folder.

Value

The path of the results file. It is <home>/<version>_results/results.qs2 when data_raw is NULL, and <home>/<version>_results/scenario/<name>/results.qs2 otherwise. <name> is the basename of the normalised data_raw.

See also

Other project setup: initialize_project()

Examples

# \donttest{
home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_run_example")
dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_functions"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(home, "data"))
writeLines(
  c(
    'pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", data_raw = "data")',
    "pbn::save_results(",
    "  exclusions = data.frame(",
    "    step = character(0), n_before = numeric(0),",
    "    n_excluded = numeric(0), n_after = numeric(0)",
    "  ),",
    "  estimates = data.frame(term = 'x', estimate = 1),",
    "  tables = list()",
    ")"
  ),
  file.path(home, "v01_run.R")
)
pbn::run_version("v01", home = home)
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpzsUfWf/pbn_run_example/v01_results/results.qs2"

unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)
# }
